name: econoscope
description: EconoScope - geospatial intelligence platform that detects economic activity beyond official records (Goa pilot)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
